msg: Hi!In this game there are four pairs of gnomes that appear. They are red & yellow, pink & green, orange & brown, and blue & purple. They will vary on which side of the screen they appear, so concentrate on the colours rather than positions. The most important thing to remember is that 4 of the gnomes lead to one forest, and the other 4 to a different forest. Remember these groups of colours. The red, blue, orange and green gnomes will always take you to a brightly lit, green forest with a red basket in the centre. The pink, purple, yellow and brown gnomes will always take you to a forest that's in darker colours with a yellow basket in the centre.You want to find the forest that currently has the most mushrooms, as this will vary.  Be on the lookout for changes in volume of mushrooms. Sometimes one forest will be great for a good while, and sometimes it changes quickly. I tended to see how things were in the other forest when it dropped below 5 mushrooms per turn. Try to always aim for the forest that is currently being generous. Concentrate on the colour of the gnomes and keeping track of the number of mushrooms from the last turn. Don't stick to the same forest if it's not being generous, and you'll get lots of mushrooms. Good luck!Remember the groups: Red, blue, orange and green for the red basket forest. Pink, purple, yellow and brown for the yellow basket forest.
